notes: Sepolia only (chain 11155111). Deploy VerdictBurnVault, VerdictOracle and VerdictMarkets in this order. $owner resolves to 0x397dacb1ee8e9a8ce5196988958f56bde0a0a312 and controls oracle configuration and the markets guardian role; the same owner receives treasury fees. VerdictBurnVault is a permanent ERC-20 sink. Oracle requests initially cost 0.5 IMD, with a zero configuration delay. Immutable collateral slot 0 is test IMD with creator/burn/treasury fees of 150/50/50 bps and a 500 IMD pool cap; slot 1 is Sepolia WETH with fees of 150/0/100 bps and a 1 WETH pool cap. Bets, payouts, refunds and fees use the selected collateral. Bounties, oracle payments and settler rewards use the oracle asset recorded at market creation, initially IMD; asset changes block further asks for existing markets until the asset matches again. Maximum per-action settler reward is 0.25 IMD. The creator allowlist starts enabled and entry starts unpaused. WETH is used as an ERC-20, with no native ETH path. agentId is a caller-supplied label, not a verified identity. Agent guidance and exact ABIs are in docs/AGENTS.md and docs/agents/abi/; deployment addresses are recorded by the deployment handoff in docs/agents/addresses.json.
